# Performance and visibility: build rules

Apply these rules while you build. Domains or criteria whose `applies_if` flags are false in `.quality/project.json` do not apply to this project. Before you call a task done, check your work against the criteria of the domains you touched: each one must be true and verifiable.

If a stack module of the quality pack is installed (qp-nextjs, qp-node-api, qp-vps), its rules skill adds stack-specific rules on top of these.

## Performance (PRF)

Asset compression, query optimisation and speed.

Rules:

- Set a budget from the start: LCP under 2.5 s, INP under 200 ms, CLS under 0.1 on mobile.
- Images in AVIF or WebP, sized, lazy-loaded below the fold, with reserved dimensions.
- Self-hosted fonts, useful subset, font-display: swap.
- No query in a loop (N+1); paginate every list that can grow.
- gzip or brotli compression and HTTP caching on static assets.

Done means:

- [major] PRF-01: Core Web Vitals within budget on mobile (LCP, INP, CLS) (only if: has_ui). Check: Lighthouse mobile on main pages; field data if available.
- [major] PRF-02: No N+1 query or unpaginated list (only if: has_db). Check: Read data access inside loops; log the queries of one page.
- [major] PRF-03: Images optimised, sized and lazy-loaded (only if: has_ui). Check: Modern formats, srcset or image component, width and height present.
- [minor] PRF-04: JavaScript shipped to the client within budget (only if: has_ui). Check: Bundle analysis; heavy dependencies replaced or loaded on demand.
- [minor] PRF-05: Compression and HTTP caching active on static assets. Check: content-encoding and cache-control headers on JS, CSS, images, fonts.
- [minor] PRF-06: API response time measured and reasonable (only if: has_backend). Check: p95 of main routes under 500 ms under normal load.

## SEO and meta (SEO)

Search ranking, indexing, metadata, OpenGraph and favicons.

Applies when: Public pages meant to be found on the web.

Rules:

- Every public page has a unique title and description, a readable URL and a canonical tag.
- Important content is in the served HTML (server or static rendering), not only client-generated.
- Provide sitemap.xml, robots.txt, OpenGraph, Twitter Card, favicons and manifest.
- Private and staging pages are not indexable.

Done means:

- [BLOCKER] SEO-01: Public pages are indexable and staging is not. Check: No accidental noindex in production; noindex or password on staging.
- [major] SEO-02: Unique title, description and canonical on every public page. Check: Crawl the site and detect duplicates and gaps.
- [major] SEO-03: Complete OpenGraph and Twitter Card with a dedicated image. Check: og:title, og:description, og:image (1200 × 630), og:url; preview tested.
- [major] SEO-04: Main content present in the served HTML. Check: curl the page: main text is in the response.
- [minor] SEO-05: sitemap.xml, robots.txt, favicons and manifest present and valid. Check: Fetch each file; favicons in several sizes and apple-touch-icon.
- [minor] SEO-06: Structured data suited to the site type. Check: JSON-LD Organization, LocalBusiness, Product or Article as relevant, validated.
- [minor] SEO-07: Correct hreflang tags for language versions (only if: multilingual). Check: Each version points to the others and to itself.

## Scalability (SCL)

Holding up under load.

Applies when: The project has a server or API.

Rules:

- Estimate expected load (concurrent users, peaks) at /kickoff and size for it, without oversizing.
- Stateless server in local memory: sessions, queues and locks in Redis or the database, so several instances can run.
- Long tasks go through a queue, not the HTTP request.

Done means:

- [major] SCL-01: Load test at expected load without errors. Check: k6 or autocannon on main routes; error rate and p95 recorded.
- [major] SCL-02: No critical state kept only in one instance's memory. Check: Sessions, real-time rooms, counters: stored or synced outside the process (Redis adapter for Socket.io).
- [minor] SCL-03: Long tasks processed in the background. Check: Email sending, file processing, exports: job queue.
- [minor] SCL-04: Database connection pool sized. Check: Pool size consistent with instance count and database limit.
